author: reek
body: Does the body of a two-parameter function resolve each parameter name to the register the prologue bound it to? Nothing here recurses, matches, or tail-calls. Each function ignores one parameter and returns the other, so the answer names which register the body actually read.

author: reek
body: take-first 1 2 must be 1. take-second 1 2 must be 2. If the two answers are exchanged, the body's name-to-register mapping disagrees with the prologue and every other symptom in this area is downstream of that.

author: reek
body: The three-parameter case is here because a swap of two adjacent bindings and a full reversal of the list are different defects with the same signature at arity two.
